assets.prompt: Create one high-quality isolated EMPTY 2D inventory UI panel skin for an illustrated dungeon action game about travelling artisan explorers using relic technology. Reference screenshot is STYLE/PALETTE and overall readable layout reference ONLY. IMPORTANT: do NOT reproduce any text, guns, relic items, grid, buttons, or screenshot background. Smooth dark illustrated outlines, broad 3-tone shading, subdued worn dark metal, tarnished brass/copper, slate teal, leather suspension pads, very little noisy grain. Not photoreal, not pixel art, not generic blue hologram or military sci-fi dashboard. Functional portable craft apparatus from a ruin-adventure world. Transparent exterior only, opaque interior. Flat straight-on orthographic interface, no perspective. Panel fills 96% canvas, landscape 7:5 ratio. Keep center 80% of panel EMPTY very dark matte teal, suitable for readable cream typography and inventory contents added later. No internal divider. Mechanical construction should be recognizable but confined to outer 7% perimeter. No labels or lettering, no gauges suggesting a resource mechanic. Direction A: an opened travelling artisan's powered maintenance case. A rigid dark iron chassis with broad battered brass corner clamps, a leather carrying grip at top edge, two small amber-green glass power tubes housed vertically in a sturdy protective brass cage integrated into the FAR LEFT OUTER BORDER. Insulated dark copper conduits run from the tubes along the outside rim into a few utilitarian connector blocks. Narrow warm amber light in a few connector joints. Leather gaskets cushion the frame, a quiet slate backing board inside. Distinctly a working portable machine rather than a textile bag. Mechanisms broad and readable, just 4-6 main parts, no gear clutter. No large glow across interior.
